notes: IMDTools is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with ordinary, untaxed transfers. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 TOOLS with 18 decimals once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It exposes no post-deployment mint, burn, ownership, pause, blacklist or upgrade entrypoints. No application contracts or initialization calls are included. The pool pairs TOOLS with IMD. initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
